issues.sym: Misfires, rough idle, stumbling or shaking under acceleration, a check engine light, or the engine won't start, often after rain or washing the engine.
issues.why: The OptiSpark distributor sits low at the front of the engine behind the water pump. Moisture gets inside through its small vents, and a leaking water pump can drip coolant onto it.
issues.next: Have the ignition codes and the distributor checked. Fix any water pump leak at the same time, since it often caused the failure. A vented replacement unit lasts longer.

issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs, white exhaust smoke, coolant loss, rough running or milky residue under the oil cap.
issues.why: Coolant leaks and cooling system failures on the LT1-family engine lead to overheating, which can blow a head gasket.
issues.next: Stop driving if the engine overheats and have it towed. A cooling system pressure test and a combustion leak test will show whether the head gasket is damaged.

issues.t: Low coolant light on with a full radiator
issues.sym: The low coolant warning stays on even though the coolant is full and there are no leaks.
issues.why: The coolant level sensor on the radiator fails. It does not affect how the engine runs.
issues.next: Confirm the coolant really is full with the engine cold. If it is, replacing the sensor is a cheap, simple job.

issues.sym: A "Service Column Lock" message, the car won't start, or the steering wheel locks.
issues.why: The electronic steering column lock module fails. GM recalled C5s (04V-060) because the lock could engage while driving. Many owners also fit a bypass after the module fails.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If you see the column lock message, get it looked at right away rather than risk a locked wheel or being stranded.

issues.t: ABS and traction control module failure
issues.sym: ABS, traction control and Active Handling warnings stay on, and anti-lock braking stops working.
issues.why: The early C5 brake control module (EBCM) fails, and these 1997–2000 units are hard to find and generally can't be repaired.
issues.next: Normal braking still works. A shop can confirm the module is at fault; many owners swap in a later 2001–2004 module.

issues.sym: The crank pulley wobbles at idle, a belt chirps or wears quickly, or a vibration comes and goes at certain RPMs.
issues.why: The two-piece harmonic balancer's rubber bond breaks down and the outer ring slips. If it comes apart it can shred belts and damage the steering rack, timing cover or crankshaft.
issues.next: Look at the front pulley with the engine idling. Any wobble means replacing the balancer soon, along with a new crank bolt.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads empty or jumps around
issues.sym: The fuel gauge suddenly drops to empty or reads incorrectly.
issues.why: Sulfur in fuel coats the sending unit contacts, or the fuel level sensor fails. It is the most-reported Corvette problem on RepairPal.
issues.next: Track mileage between fill-ups. Some owners see improvement with a fuel system cleaner; otherwise the sending unit has to be replaced.

issues.t: Raw fuel smell from cracked tank crossover hose
issues.sym: A strong raw gasoline smell around the car.
issues.why: The hose that connects the C5's two fuel tanks cracks with age.
issues.next: A fuel smell is a fire risk; have it checked soon. Repair is labor-heavy because the rear drivetrain must be lowered.

issues.t: Driver and passenger sides blow different temperatures
issues.sym: One side of the cabin blows hot and the other cold, or the temperature won't change.
issues.why: The plastic gears in an HVAC blend door actuator crack. The actuator is buried in the dash.
issues.next: A shop can confirm which actuator failed. Expect several hours of labor to reach it.

issues.sym: One pop-up headlight grinds for several seconds and stops halfway or doesn't come up.
issues.why: The plastic gears inside the headlight lift motor strip.
issues.next: Drive with care at night if a light is stuck. A gear kit or a replacement motor fixes it.

issues.sym: Wet carpet on the passenger side, or water dripping under the dash after rain.
issues.why: Leaves and debris clog the cowl drains below the windshield, so water backs up into the car. It can damage the body control module.
issues.next: Clear the cowl drains and dry the carpet quickly. Check the electronics under the passenger dash if they got wet.

issues.t: Clunk or vibration from the torque tube coupler
issues.sym: Rattling, clunking or shudder from under the center console on shifts or acceleration, or slop in the driveline.
issues.why: The rubber couplers (guibos) at each end of the torque tube dry-rot and split, often around 100,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the couplers inspected. Replacing them is a big job, so check the clutch at the same time on manual cars.

issues.sym: Extra valvetrain noise, burning oil, fouled plugs, misfires, and in the worst case a dropped valve and ruined engine.
issues.why: The LS7's factory valve guides wear quickly, which lets the heavy titanium intake valves wobble. GM traced it to cylinder heads from one supplier, and owners filed a class action.
issues.next: Have a shop do a valve guide "wiggle" test, especially before buying. Reworked heads with bronze guides are the common fix.

issues.t: Strong fuel smell from tank or fuel pump
issues.sym: A strong gasoline smell in the garage or cabin, often near the driver's rear fender and worse with a fuller tank.
issues.why: Cracked fuel pump housings, elbows, sending units or tanks leak fuel vapor. GM issued a service bulletin.
issues.next: Treat a fuel smell as a fire risk. Have it inspected right away; a dealer can check the GM bulletin.

issues.sym: The removable roof or fixed roof panel loosens or comes off.
issues.why: The adhesive that bonds the roof panel to its frame can let go. GM recalled these cars (06V-181 and 09V-491).
issues.next: Check for an open recall and have it done. Don't drive at speed if the roof feels loose.

issues.sym: The low-beam headlights stop working, often suddenly.
issues.why: A wire in the headlamp circuit can fracture. GM recalled the cars (14V-251).
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If the low beams fail, use high beams carefully and get it fixed.

issues.t: Air intake filter pad comes loose
issues.sym: Rough idle, misfires, lean-running codes or mass airflow sensor codes such as P0101 or P0171.
issues.why: A foam hydrocarbon pad glued inside the air intake can come unstuck and get sucked into the intake duct, blocking airflow. It has been a problem since the C6.
issues.next: Have the intake box checked for a loose pad. Removing it is common and simple.

issues.t: Overheating and limp mode on the Z06
issues.sym: Overheating warnings and reduced power (limp mode) during long, hard driving or on track.
issues.why: The supercharged Z06 struggles to shed heat. GM changed the hood, supercharger cover, radiators and transmission tuning, and extended coverage for 2015–2018 cars.
issues.next: Back off and let it cool. Ask a dealer whether your car got the cooling updates; track drivers often add extra coolers.

issues.sym: A tire that keeps losing air, a vibration at highway speed, or visible cracks in the wheel.
issues.why: The cast-aluminum wheels on Z06 and Grand Sport models crack or bend from pothole hits. Owners filed class-action lawsuits.
issues.next: Check the inside of each wheel for cracks if a tire keeps going flat. Replace a cracked wheel; don't repair it.

issues.sym: A shudder like driving over rumble strips at steady speeds, jerky or hard shifts, or surging in traffic.
issues.why: The original transmission fluid absorbs moisture and causes torque converter shudder. GM's bulletin (18-NA-355) calls for flushing in a new fluid, and some converters need replacing.
issues.next: Ask a dealer for the fluid flush bulletin. If the shudder continues, the torque converter may need replacing.

issues.sym: The center touchscreen goes black or flickers, and the radio and audio stop working.
issues.why: Loose cables on the infotainment module behind the driver's kick panel, or a bad connector. GM bulletin PI1149A lists the checks.
issues.next: Ask a shop to reseat the module connectors before replacing the screen.

issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes very heavy and takes much more effort.
issues.why: The electric power steering can lose assist. GM recalled these cars (19V-086 and 25V-175).
issues.next: Get the free recall repair. If assist fails, slow down and steer firmly to a safe stop.

issues.sym: Usually no warning at all; sometimes an airbag light.
issues.why: A software issue could start a self-test that blocks the front airbags and belt pretensioners in a crash. GM recalled the cars (16V-651 and 17V-437).
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the free software update done.

issues.sym: Hard or rough shifts, bucking or shudder, trouble pulling away in first gear, warning messages, or codes such as P2724.
issues.why: Early C8 dual-clutch transmissions had faults that GM has fixed with fluid changes, control module updates or transmission replacement.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for codes and updates while the car is under warranty.

issues.sym: Misfires, rough running, lost power, a ticking noise, or codes such as P0300.
issues.why: A bad batch of valve springs went into engines built between June and September 2020. GM's bulletin calls for new springs and a leak-down test.
issues.next: If you have misfires, ask a dealer whether your engine is in the affected build range.

issues.sym: The engine cranks 10 seconds or more before starting, or won't start; code P12A6 is common.
issues.why: Internal faults in the engine control module. GM's bulletin calls for reprogramming or replacing it.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for the code and the bulletin.

issues.t: Front trunk latch and release problems (recalls)
issues.sym: The front trunk lid may not be fully latched while driving, or the inside release may stop working.
issues.why: GM recalled 2020 cars because the front trunk could be driven unlatched (20V-489) and the interior release could stop working after the car is turned off (20V-461).
issues.next: Check for open recalls. Make sure the front trunk is fully closed before driving.

issues.t: Rear axle shaft may be missing a bearing (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: Some rear half-shaft assemblies were built without a ball bearing. GM recalled them (22V-091).
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and get the repair done.

issues.sym: Oily residue under the car, fluid puddles, or transmission failure.
issues.why: Owners report cracked or porous transmission housings that leak fluid.
issues.next: Have any fluid leak checked right away while the car is under warranty.

issues.sym: A tapping or ticking noise from the Z06 engine.
issues.why: GM says some ticking is normal for the flat-plane LT6, but loud noise has been linked to misaligned camshaft caps.
issues.next: If the noise is loud or changing, have a dealer inspect it under warranty.

issues.t: Fuel can spill near hot parts when refueling (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell after filling up, or fuel in the filler pocket.
issues.why: Extra fuel can spill into the filler pocket and reach hot engine or exhaust parts. GM recalled the cars (25V-536) to add a shield.
issues.next: Don't top off the tank. Check your VIN and have the free shield installed.

issues.t: Front seat belts can lock in the stowed position (recall)
issues.sym: A front seat belt won't pull out of the retractor.
issues.why: The front belt retractors may lock up while stowed. GM recalled the cars (24V-418).
issues.next: If a belt won't come out, get it fixed before carrying that passenger. Check for the free recall.

issues.t: No warning when a rear turn signal burns out (recall)
issues.sym: You may not get a dash warning when a rear turn signal stops working.
issues.why: A software error in the exterior lighting module fails to detect a failed rear turn signal. GM recalled the cars (26V-213).
issues.next: Check your VIN; the fix is a free software update at a dealer or over the air.

issues.t: Owner's manual may not download to the screen (recall)
issues.sym: The electronic owner's manual is missing from the infotainment screen.
issues.why: The radio may not have been set up at the factory to download the electronic manual. GM recalled many 2026 models, including Corvettes (26V-114).
issues.next: A dealer will reset the radio for free.
